newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Tuesday:

Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said Commissioner Cresson and Societe Generale de Belgique chairman Etienne Davignon would hold a joint news conference on the fourth research framework programme at 1230/1130 GMT on Wednesday.
Van der Pas said Commissioner Ritt Bjerregaard would hold a news conference on the Commission communication establishing joint action in water policy at 1300/1200 GMT on Wednesday.

Van der Pas also announced that the Commission, the World Bank and the former Republic of Macedonia would hold a joint news conference at the International Press Centre at 1430/1330 GMT on Wednesday on the G24 donors conference.

In answer to a question spokesman Gerry Kieley said the Commission had not received the expected communication on BSE from the UK government so far. He also said that when it arrived, this herd scheme for the lifting of the export ban of UK beef would be examined by the scientific veterinary committee, the multidisciplinary committee and any other appropriate scientific committee. He said it was not possible to give a timetable yet.

Van der Pas said Commissioner Fischler's communication fixing farm product prices for 1997-1998 was on the Commission's Wednesday meeting agenda despite the fact that it was not included on the provisional agenda available to journalists.
Spokesman Nicolaas Wegter said the Commission hoped that a common position on Cyprus would be reached at the Council as soon as possible.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/149: The Commission initiates second phase proceedings on the take-over of the Dutch operations of Toys 'R Us by Blokker.
- IP/97/150: The Commission approves the acquisition by UPM-Kymmene of Finnpap in the Finnish paper industry.
- IP/97/151: Commissioner van den Broek visits Cyprus.
- IP/97/153: European Commission and World Bank co-operation in Africa moves into a higher gear.
- Speech/97/43: Speech by Commissioner Karel Van Miert on 'British Airways and American Airlines".
- Memo/97/19: Relations between the EU and Central America.
- DGX - Results of "continuous tracking" surveys of European opinion - September 1996 to January 1997.
- Eurostat - Statistics in focus - Economy and Finance No1997-7: The EU trade in transportation services.
